name: Instagram (Instagram Login)
description: Run an Instagram business or creator account without a Facebook Page: profile, posts, reels and stories, account and post insights, comments and mentions, Direct Messages, and publishing (installed switched off). Sign in with Instagram, or paste a long-lived token.
instructions:
## Instagram (Instagram API with Instagram Login)
This connector calls the Graph API at `https://graph.instagram.com/v25.0` for one Instagram professional account (business or creator). Unlike the **Instagram** connector (Facebook Login), it needs no Facebook Page and no Meta Business account. Personal Instagram accounts have no API access.

**Sign in (recommended).** On the connector page click **Authorize with Instagram**, sign in with the Instagram account and approve the permissions. AnythingMCP stores a long-lived token (60 days) in `INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN`, fills in `INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID` and refreshes the token before it expires. On a server with its own Meta app (AnythingMCP Cloud) there is nothing to set up. Otherwise create a Meta app with the Instagram product (API setup with Instagram login), copy the **Instagram app ID** and **Instagram app secret** from Business login settings into `INSTAGRAM_APP_ID` and `INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET`, and add `<your AnythingMCP address>/api/meta/callback` to its OAuth redirect URIs (on AnythingMCP Cloud: `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/meta/callback`). An app in development mode works for accounts that have a role on the app (Standard Access); serving other people's accounts needs Meta App Review (Advanced Access).

**Or paste a token.** A long-lived Instagram User token (it starts with IG) from the app's API setup with Instagram login page, with the account's numeric id in `INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID` (`instagram_login_get_account` returns it as `user_id`). It is refreshed automatically once it is a day old.

Permissions asked for: `instagram_business_basic`, `instagram_business_manage_insights`, `instagram_business_manage_comments`, `instagram_business_content_publish`, `instagram_business_manage_messages`.

**Which tool first.** `instagram_login_get_account` checks the setup and returns follower and media counts. Tools that act on the account take its id from the connector, so you never pass it.

**Ids.** Media ids come from `instagram_login_list_media`, `instagram_login_list_stories` or `instagram_login_list_tagged_media`; comment ids from `instagram_login_list_comments`; conversation ids from `instagram_login_list_conversations`; a person's IGSID from a conversation's `participants` or a message's `from`. Pass ids unchanged.

**Fields and pages.** The API returns only the fields asked for; every read tool has a `fields` parameter with a sensible default (nested fields in braces, e.g. `children{media_url}`). List answers carry `paging.cursors.after`: call again with `after` set to it until `paging.next` is missing.

**Insights.** Account insights need `metric` and `period=day`; most metrics also need `metric_type=total_value`. Demographic metrics need `period=lifetime`, `metric_type=total_value`, `timeframe` and a `breakdown` (age, city, country, gender) and are empty below 100 followers. Data can lag up to 48 hours; a metric that does not apply returns an error rather than zero.

**Comments and mentions.** Read, create, reply to, hide and delete comments on the account's own posts, and turn commenting off per post. `instagram_login_list_tagged_media` lists posts the account is tagged in; `instagram_login_reply_to_mention` answers an @mention in someone else's comment or caption.

**Direct Messages.** `instagram_login_list_conversations`, `instagram_login_get_conversation_messages` and `instagram_login_get_message` read the inbox (only the 20 most recent messages of a conversation have content). Sending is switched off at install: `instagram_login_send_message` works only within 24 hours of the person's last message, and `instagram_login_send_private_reply` answers a comment once, privately, within 7 days.

**Publishing** (switched off at install): create a container with `instagram_login_create_media_container` (media at a public HTTPS URL), check `instagram_login_get_container_status` until `status_code` is `FINISHED`, then `instagram_login_publish_media`. For a carousel, create 2 to 10 items with `is_carousel_item=true`, then a `CAROUSEL` container with their ids in `children`. `instagram_login_get_publishing_limit` shows the 24-hour usage.

**Not here.** Hashtag search, other accounts' profiles (business discovery) and deleting posts exist only in the Instagram API with Facebook Login: use the **Instagram** connector for those.

**Rate limits.** A 400 with error code 4, 17, 32 or 613 means throttled: wait and retry. Error 190 means the token expired or was revoked (authorize again); error 10 or 200 means a permission is missing.
prerequisites: An Instagram **business or creator** account (no Facebook Page needed). On AnythingMCP Cloud you just sign in with Instagram; elsewhere you also need a Meta app with the Instagram product (API setup with Instagram login). Personal Instagram accounts have no API access.

INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Access token
INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Filled in by Authorize with Instagram on the connector page. To paste one instead: Meta App Dashboard, Instagram, API setup with Instagram login, Generate access tokens, your account. A long-lived token (60 days) is refreshed automatically.
INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the token alone, without the word Bearer or spaces.

INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID.label: Instagram account ID
INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID.help: Filled in by Authorize with Instagram. Otherwise the user_id that instagram_login_get_account returns: a number, not the username.
INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID.patternMessage: The account id is a number. It is not the Instagram username.

INSTAGRAM_APP_ID.label: Instagram app ID (optional)
INSTAGRAM_APP_ID.help: Only with an app of your own (leave empty on a server with its own Meta app, such as AnythingMCP Cloud). Meta App Dashboard, Instagram, API setup with Instagram login, Business login settings: Instagram app ID. It differs from the Meta app's own App ID.
INSTAGRAM_APP_ID.patternMessage: The Instagram app ID is a number, shown under Business login settings.

INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET.label: Instagram app secret (optional)
INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET.help: Only with an app of your own, together with INSTAGRAM_APP_ID: Business login settings, Instagram app secret. Stored encrypted and sent only to Instagram when you authorize.
INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET.patternMessage: The Instagram app secret is 32 characters, digits and the letters a to f.

verifyHints.400: Instagram refused the request. Error 190 means the token is invalid or expired: authorize again with Instagram. If the message says the object does not exist, check INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID (the number instagram_login_get_account returns, not the username).
verifyHints.401: Instagram refused the token, or it has expired (error 190). Click Authorize with Instagram on the connector page, or paste a new long-lived token.
verifyHints.403: The token lacks a permission (error 10 or 200). Authorize again and approve every permission the app asks for.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Instagram is rate limiting this account or app (error 4, 17, 32 or 613). Wait a few minutes and try again.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_account
tools.description: Get the connected Instagram professional account: id, username, name, account type, biography, website, profile picture and follower, following and media counts. Call it first to check the setup.

tools.name: instagram_login_list_media
tools.description: List the account's published posts and reels, newest first, with caption, type, link, timestamp and like and comment counts. Use it to find a media id for insights, comments or moderation.

after.description: Cursor from paging.cursors.after of the previous answer, for the next page.

since.description: Only media published after this Unix timestamp.

until.description: Only media published before this Unix timestamp.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_media
tools.description: Get one post, reel, story or carousel by id, with caption, type, media URL, permalink, counts and, for a carousel, its items.

media_id.description: Media id from instagram_login_list_media or instagram_login_list_stories.

tools.name: instagram_login_list_stories
tools.description: List the account's stories that are live now (stories disappear after 24 hours), with media URL, permalink and timestamp.

tools.name: instagram_login_list_tagged_media
tools.description: List public posts by other accounts in which this account is tagged, with the author's username, caption and link.

after.description: Cursor from paging.cursors.after of the previous answer, for the next page.

tools.name: instagram_login_reply_to_mention
tools.description: Reply to a comment or a caption by another account that @mentions this account. The reply is posted as this account under that comment or post. Pass media_id alone to comment on the post whose caption mentions the account, or media_id and comment_id to reply to a mentioning comment.

media_id.description: Id of the post where the account was @mentioned.

comment_id.description: Id of the comment that @mentions the account. Leave empty when the mention is in the caption.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_account_insights
tools.description: Get account-level insights: reach, views, accounts_engaged, total_interactions, likes, comments, shares, saves, replies, follows_and_unfollows, profile_links_taps, or follower and engaged-audience demographics. Returns one entry per metric, per day (time_series) or as a total (total_value).

metric.description: Comma-separated metrics, e.g. reach,views,accounts_engaged,total_interactions. Demographics: follower_demographics or engaged_audience_demographics, one per call.

period.description: day for interaction metrics, lifetime for demographic metrics.

metric_type.description: total_value returns one total for the range (needed for most metrics and every breakdown); time_series returns values per day (reach).

breakdown.description: Optional split: media_product_type, follow_type, follower_type or contact_button_type for interactions; age, city, country or gender for demographics.

since.description: Start of the range as a Unix timestamp; at most 30 days before until.

until.description: End of the range as a Unix timestamp.

timeframe.description: Required for demographic metrics, instead of since and until.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_media_insights
tools.description: Get insights for one post, reel or story: reach, views, likes, comments, saved, shares, total_interactions and, for stories, replies and navigation. Stories have insights only while live (24 hours).

media_id.description: Media id from instagram_login_list_media or instagram_login_list_stories.

metric.description: Comma-separated metrics. Posts and reels: reach,views,likes,comments,saved,shares,total_interactions. Stories: reach,views,replies,navigation.

breakdown.description: Optional: action_type with the navigation metric of a story.

tools.name: instagram_login_list_comments
tools.description: List the top-level comments on one of the account's posts or reels, newest first, with text, username, timestamp, likes, hidden flag and the replies under each. Use it to read a conversation or to find a comment id.

after.description: Cursor from paging.cursors.after of the previous answer, for the next page.

tools.name: instagram_login_list_comment_replies
tools.description: List the replies under one comment, with text, username and timestamp.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_comment
tools.description: Get one comment by id: text, author, timestamp, likes, hidden flag, the post it belongs to and its replies.

comment_id.description: Comment id from instagram_login_list_comments or a webhook.

tools.name: instagram_login_create_comment
tools.description: Post a new top-level comment, as this account, on one of the account's own posts or reels. Returns the new comment id. To answer someone, use instagram_login_reply_to_comment instead.

tools.name: instagram_login_reply_to_comment
tools.description: Reply, as this account, to a comment on one of the account's posts. The reply appears under that comment. Returns the reply id.

tools.name: instagram_login_hide_comment
tools.description: Hide or unhide a comment on one of the account's posts. A hidden comment stays visible to its author only. Returns success true.

hide.description: true to hide the comment, false to show it again.

tools.name: instagram_login_delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment on one of the account's posts, for everyone. This cannot be undone; hiding it is the reversible alternative. Returns success true.

tools.name: instagram_login_set_comments_enabled
tools.description: Turn commenting on or off for one of the account's posts or reels. Existing comments stay; while off, nobody can add new ones. Returns success true.

enabled.description: true to allow comments, false to turn them off.

tools.name: instagram_login_create_media_container
tools.description: Step 1 of publishing: create a container for an image post, a reel, a story or a carousel item from a public HTTPS URL. Returns the container id. Nothing is published until instagram_login_publish_media is called with it. Containers expire after 24 hours.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a JPEG image, for an image post, an image story or an image carousel item.

video_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of an MP4 or MOV video, for a reel, a video story or a video carousel item.

media_type.description: Empty for a single image post. REELS for a reel, STORIES for a story, CAROUSEL for the parent of a carousel (with children), VIDEO for a video carousel item.

caption.description: Caption, up to 2200 characters, 30 hashtags and 20 @mentions. Not used for stories or carousel items.

is_carousel_item.description: true when this container is one item of a carousel created afterwards.

children.description: For media_type CAROUSEL: comma-separated container ids of 2 to 10 carousel items.

cover_url.description: Reels only: public HTTPS URL of a cover image.

share_to_feed.description: Reels only: also show the reel in the main feed (default true).

alt_text.description: Image posts only: text for screen readers, up to 1000 characters.

collaborators.description: Optional: comma-separated usernames (up to 3) invited as collaborators of a post or reel.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_container_status
tools.description: Check whether a media container is ready to publish. status_code is IN_PROGRESS while a video is processed, FINISHED when it can be published, ERROR or EXPIRED otherwise (status says why).

tools.name: instagram_login_publish_media
tools.description: Step 2 of publishing: publish a container whose status_code is FINISHED. Returns the id of the published media. The post is public at once and counts against the 24-hour publishing limit.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_publishing_limit
tools.description: Show how many posts the account published through the API in the last 24 hours and the limit that applies.

tools.name: instagram_login_list_conversations
tools.description: List the Direct Message conversations of the account, most recently active first, with the participants and the time of the last message. Pass user_id to find the conversation with one person. Conversations in the Requests folder inactive for 30 days are not listed.

user_id.description: Instagram-scoped id (IGSID) of a person, to get only the conversation with them.

after.description: Cursor from paging.cursors.after of the previous answer, for the next page.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_conversation_messages
tools.description: Read the messages of one Direct Message conversation, newest first, with sender, recipient, text and time. Only the 20 most recent messages have their content; older ones return only ids.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_message
tools.description: Get one Direct Message by id: sender, recipient, text, attachments and time. Only the 20 most recent messages of a conversation can be read.

message_id.description: Message id from instagram_login_get_conversation_messages or a webhook.

tools.name: instagram_login_get_user_profile
tools.description: Get the public profile of a person who messaged or commented, from their Instagram-scoped id (IGSID): name, username, profile picture, follower count and whether they follow the account or the account follows them. Works only for people who have messaged the account.

user_id.description: Instagram-scoped id (IGSID) from a conversation participant or a message sender.

tools.name: instagram_login_send_message
tools.description: Send a Direct Message, as the account, to a person who wrote to it. Allowed only within 24 hours of their last message (the standard messaging window). Text up to 1000 bytes; links are sent as text. Returns recipient_id and message_id.

recipient_id.description: Instagram-scoped id (IGSID) of the person, from a conversation participant or a message sender.

tools.name: instagram_login_send_private_reply
tools.description: Answer a comment on one of the account's posts with a private Direct Message to its author. One private reply per comment, within 7 days of the comment. Returns recipient_id and message_id.
